Definition: Ziza, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ziza is the name of two different men. One was a son of Shiphi, a chief of the Simeonites in Hezekiah's day; the other was a son of Rehoboam by Maachah, the granddaughter of Absalom. Two lives, one name, separated by generations — and Scripture keeps them straight by naming each man's father.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two Zizas remind me to read names carefully: God knows which man He means, even when the name is the same.
RelatedPeople: Ziza, Son of Shiphi; Ziza, Son of Rehoboam
